_comment: Emberreach trader. Settlement stores are exchanged here for things the frontier cannot produce itself, which is what stops those stores from being a number with no purpose. 'cost' is paid from the settlement store (see TownshipManager.ALL_RESOURCES); 'grant_items' goes to your storage through the guaranteed path so a crate can never be lost to a full store; 'grant_currency' is added to a player currency. 'requires_building' gates an offer behind a structure level.

trader_timber.name: Timber Crate
trader_timber.description: Sawn, dried and banded. A crate of settlement timber, packed for your own benches.

trader_provisions.name: Provisions Crate
trader_provisions.description: Salted, smoked and sealed. Rations that keep a party on its feet.

trader_bars.name: Smelted Crate
trader_bars.description: Fresh bars, still warm from the mould.

trader_reagents.name: Reagent Crate
trader_reagents.description: Dried herbs, tinctures and a sealed jar the apothecary will not explain.

trader_compost.name: Compost Heap
trader_compost.description: Turned, rotted and ready. Improves crop survival in your own plots.

trader_star_dust.name: Sift the Terrace Dust
trader_star_dust.description: The terrace sweeps its instruments clean into a barrel. Sift it for Starreading dust.

trader_prayer.name: Observance
trader_prayer.description: The shrine keeps the old rite on your behalf and its store of faith becomes yours.

trader_levy.name: Sell the Surplus
trader_levy.description: Trade goods, drill hours and expedition supplies sold to passing caravans for coin.
